title: Netherite Combat Effects
description: Netherite Sword applies Slowness to enemies, Hoe grants Speed I, Pickaxe/Shovel/Axe provide Haste II, and Full Netherite Armor grants Regeneration.
body:
### **_Netherite Combat Effects:_**

is a Minecraft data pack for version 1.20 -1.20.1 It enhances Netherite gear with extra effects:

Hitting enemies with a Netherite sword gives them Slowness 2.

Using Netherite Pickaxe/axe/shovel gives you Haste 2.

A Netherite hoe gives you Speed 1

Wearing a full set of Netherite armor gives you Regeneration.

You can edit the data pack files to change how strong or long the effects last.
Available on curseforge too: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/netherite-combat-effects](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/netherite-combat-effects)

### **_IMPORTANT:_**
In-game run:

/function armor_effect:tool_effect

/function armor_effect:root

/function slowness_on_hit:tick

/function slowness_on_hit:init
